rule: A candidate route is reported only when, inside the search area, the probability within 50 m of one place is at least 0.99 (which needs a likelihood ratio of at least 99 against the best alternative found by a separate search), and the area also fits at least 99 times better than the best of 4 random decoy areas of the city.

when_footage_is_from_the_area.note: Odometry drives 00, 02, 05, 06, 07, 08, 09, 10. Drives 0018, 0020 and 0027 also fitted the noise settings, and the thresholds were chosen here

when_footage_is_from_the_area.set: KITTI fresh drives (never used for settings)
when_footage_is_from_the_area.note: Mostly short, slow or highway clips with few turns, so the system declined almost all of them

when_footage_is_from_the_area.set: Field of view stated about 5 degrees wrong, camera height unknown

when_footage_is_from_the_area.note: Turn and speed errors replayed from real KITTI video on routes through the Bengaluru road graph

when_footage_is_not_from_the_area.set: KITTI clips searched in random Bengaluru areas
Simulated Bengaluru drives searched 4 to 8 km from where they happened

summary: When the footage is from the search area, every candidate route in testing was within 50 m. When it is not, a route that is wrong can still pass, so a candidate must be confirmed with independent features before it is used.
limits: Needs a moving camera with at least a minute of driving and several turns.
Needs the camera's horizontal field of view. Wide fisheye dashcam lenses are untested.
Cannot tell on its own whether the footage was recorded inside the search area.
Validated on KITTI video from Karlsruhe and on simulated Bengaluru drives, not yet on real Bengaluru dashcam footage with GPS.
Roads missing from OpenStreetMap cannot be matched.
